lines.label: B1
lines.reason: Long 90 deg fold between base A (patch 1) and flange B (patch 3). In the perpendicular sections at 25, 50 and 75 percent, the apex sits on the outer-skin arc crest, with the nearest point 0.00/0.05/0.08 mm away. An apex sweep along the line finds fold support from t=0 to 22.5 mm on a 22.36 mm line. Support ends at the notch on one side and the flange edge on the other, so the line covers the full fold and is parallel to it. The countersunk/extruded hole in flange B is a hole feature, not a bend.

lines.label: B2
lines.reason: Short 90 deg (about 91 deg) fold between base A (patch 1) and the slanted corner tab C (patch 5). The sections at 25/50/75 percent put the apex on the outer arc crest, 0.02/0.11/0.04 mm from the nearest point. Apex support runs from t=0 to 9.0 mm on an 8.98 mm line, which is the full tab width from the notch to the outer edge. The countersunk hole in tab C is not a bend.
